Your Pune posting checklist

Use this free checklist from the day you get your orders through your first week in Pune.

  1. When your posting is confirmed

    Set an arrival window and budget for rent, deposit, travel and first-week meals. Decide whether you need a room, PG or family flat.

  2. Before you arrive

    Confirm the rent and deposit with the owner. Book a viewing, ask about handover, and check tiffin coverage for the address.

  3. On move-in day

    Check the keys, utilities and condition of the home. Save the owner’s contact and confirm your first meal delivery window.
